flags.why: The dictionary sense describes disconnected speech or writing, rather than physical hopping ([VDict](https://vdict.com/c%C3%B3c%20nh%E1%BA%A3y%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix: disjointedly; skipping from one point to another

flags.why: “Bước cóc nhảy” is unnatural and does not illustrate the disconnected-expression sense.
flags.fix: Bài văn viết cóc nhảy, ý nọ xọ ý kia. = The essay jumps disjointedly from one idea to another.

flags.why: The example explains the five ranks instead of using the expression.
flags.fix: Ông coi thường cả công hầu bá tử nam. = He held dukes, marquises, earls, viscounts and barons alike in contempt.

flags.why: The example defines the term instead of using it.
flags.fix: Bài viết phân tích vai trò của công nhân quý tộc trong phong trào lao động. = The article analyses the role of the labour aristocracy in the labour movement.

flags.why: The title denotes a ruler's or prince's daughter, especially a Nguyễn lord's daughter, rather than specifically a duke's daughter ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-c%C3%B4ng%20n%E1%BB%AF)).
flags.fix: daughter of a lord or prince (historical title)

flags.why: “Duke's daughter” assigns a specific paternal rank that “công nữ” does not establish.
flags.fix: That lord's daughter was married to a prince of a neighbouring country.
